subject: Stewardship of Intelligence runtime governance
title: Intelligence must know when to stop
summary: A real-world repeated-failure incident exposed a missing runtime enforcement layer: AI can continue executing materially equivalent actions after failure while consuming machine, financial, and human resources. Naya Power now adds a deterministic Stewardship of Intelligence contract and action gate so consequential work must establish intent, cost, verification, failure state, and stop conditions, with escalation at repeated equivalent failure.

project_context.current_objective: Prevent autonomous AI from silently repeating ineffective work and consuming disproportionate resources; convert failures into measurable future prevention.

human.summary: Shawn recognized that uncontrolled AI retries can waste substantial money, time, attention, compute, and trust, and that preventing this waste may be a foundational purpose of Naya Power.
human.content: The realization is bigger than producing AAA results. AI must learn what is worth doing, what is not worth doing, what an action costs, when an attempt is actually making progress, when failure means the strategy should change, and when the correct action is to stop and notify the human. The observed GitHub incident is treated as a concrete originating failure from which the system must learn rather than as an isolated annoyance.
lessons: Failure is information, not permission to repeat indefinitely.
Human attention and cloud resources are real costs.
AI should prevent obvious waste rather than ask the human to discover it later.
The system must be able to stop itself when continuation is unjustified.

naya.summary: Naya must optimize for verified meaningful progress rather than action volume and must treat repeated equivalent failure as a governance signal.
naya.content: The correct execution loop is INTENT → CURRENT TRUTH → GAP → PLAN → COST → CHEAP VALIDATION → EXECUTE → OBSERVE → VERIFY → LEARN → RELEASE / STOP. A retry is legitimate only when new evidence, a changed hypothesis, a corrected implementation, or another material strategy dimension justifies it. Three equivalent failures trigger mandatory strategic reassessment; five prohibit automatic equivalent repetition; ten without material strategy change are a redline requiring stop and escalation.
lessons: No retry without new information or material change.
Stop is a valid intelligent action.
Learning is incomplete until future behavior can change.

machine.equivalence_rule: Cosmetic edits, repeated commands, refreshes, wording changes, or unchanged hypotheses do not reset equivalent-attempt state.
machine.completion_invariant: Consequential work is not complete merely because an action executed; outcome evidence is required.
machine.prevention_invariant: A reusable failure lesson should become a machine-readable rule, runtime gate, test, procedure, or alert when appropriate.

psi_system_learning.principle: MAKE INTELLIGENCE WORTH THE RESOURCES IT CONSUMES.
psi_system_learning.rule: When continued action is no longer justified by new evidence or increasing probability of success, intelligence must stop.
psi_system_learning.future_behavior: Before consequential execution, establish objective, current truth, causal plan, verification plan, stop condition, and cost estimate. After failure, diagnose before retrying. Escalate equivalent failure at defined thresholds. Persist the lesson and make it available to future Naya instances.
psi_system_learning.promotion_target: Primary Intelligence / authorized downstream intelligence lifecycle

intelligent_feed.event_title: 🔱 Stewardship of Intelligence became a runtime control layer
intelligent_feed.feed_summary: Naya Power identified uncontrolled AI retry loops as a system-level waste problem and added deterministic intent, resource, failure, evidence, and stop governance.

what_changed: Created canonical Stewardship of Intelligence runtime contract.
Created deterministic action-gating runtime with persistent attempt-ledger support.
Created automated tests for missing intent, repeated failure, strategy change, five-attempt stop, and ten-attempt redline.
Established the real-world repeated-failure incident as a canonical learning event.
Connected the learning to PSI-style downstream intelligence promotion without creating a competing memory authority.

source.description: Real-world observation of repeated AI execution failures and resource consumption led to the requirement for enforceable stewardship controls.

evidence: Canonical runtime contract created in repository.
Deterministic runtime gate created in repository.
Existing three-representation Smart Note architecture and existing three-attempt/ten-attempt escalation law were inspected before adding this layer.

next_execution.objective: Wire the stewardship gate into the canonical Universal Agent execution boundary without creating a competing execution authority.
success_criteria: Consequential action cannot bypass required preflight fields.
Three/five/ten thresholds produce the specified governance decisions.
Successful completion requires evidence appropriate to the outcome.
Material failures create learning eligible for Smart Note/CIS/PIS flow.
next_execution.constraint: Do not add blind CI retries or a parallel execution engine.
